Package hadur117.twin.core

Class Gun

java.lang.Object
hadur117.twin.core.Gun
public final class Gun extends Object
TwinSaor's gun: Saor's per-opponent Markov chain (docs/saor.md, SAOR-6 and SAOR-7) on the Twin Duel's 800 x 800 field, aimed from a scan that may be a tick or two old because the partner made it (TWIN-5, TWIN-6).

A state packs acceleration sign (3 values), integer speed (17) and turn in half steps of the engine's largest turn at the last speed (5), as Saor's does. A row is a char[] of ROW + 1: successors, then the count. A playout from a state with no sample holds the state, which is circular projection; a playout through a row of fewer than WARM samples votes at most HELD_WEIGHT + TRUST a sample.

    • record

      public static void record(char[] row, int state)
      Records that state followed the row's state: a ring, so once the row is full the newest sample replaces the oldest. The count in the last slot keeps counting.
      Parameters:
      row - the row of the earlier state
      state - the state that followed

    • aim

      public static double aim(char[][] table, int state, int age, double x, double y, double tx, double ty, double heading, double velocity, double power)
      Aims: PLAYOUTS playouts of the chain from the scanned state until a bullet of power fired from (x, y) on the next tick would reach the robot, each voted into nine bins with one more vote at its centre.
      Parameters:
      table - the robot's rows
      state - its state at the scan
      age - ticks since the scan: 0 for our own scan this tick, 1 or more for a relayed one
      x - our x
      y - our y
      tx - its x at the scan
      ty - its y at the scan
      heading - its heading at the scan, radians
      velocity - its velocity at the scan
      power - the bullet's power
      Returns:
      the absolute gun heading to aim at, radians
